Most professionals use AI like a toy instead of an operating system.

The secret isn't writing complex prompts for everything. It is identifying the three most repetitive tasks in your workflow and building simple, repeatable guardrails around them.

Start small. Pick one bottleneck today, test an automated fix, and measure the time saved.
